title: Debilitate
description: [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold] are twice as effective for the next [blue]2[/blue] turns.
smart_description: [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold] are twice as effective {Amount:plural:this turn|for the next [blue]{}[/blue] turns}.
notes: Counter power that decrements each turn. The smart_description dynamically shows the remaining duration: 'this turn' when 1 turn remains, 'for the next X turns' otherwise. This power doubles the effectiveness of Vulnerable and Weak by inverting their reduction formula.
